scope: The source is one of 18 family members: put mode (INSERT OR IGNORE, INSERT OR REPLACE, or upsert), trigger (none or AFTER INSERT logging one row), and channel (main changes(), main total_changes, or main+other total_changes). Calibration receipts pin the member; the predictor simulates all consistent members and returns a value only when they agree.
lesson: The channel is not net committed effects: INSERT OR IGNORE on a duplicate yields changes()=0, REPLACE yields 1, and an AFTER INSERT trigger adds to total_changes but not changes(). Transactions buffer writes until commit; rollback discards them. The correct predictor enumerates the disclosed family, filters by every receipt's channel and committed state, and abstains unless all survivors predict the same goal value.
